articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-bench over GPT-4o and significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval tasks. The model is available through the API with a new structured-output mode designed for agentic tool-use workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a gold-medal equivalent on the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad problem set, marking the first time an AI system has consistently solved competition-level combinatorics and geometry proofs end to end. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that cross-checks intermediate reasoning steps against formal proof assistants. Researchers say the approach could accelerate automated theorem proving in production mathematics research.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in two of its Gigafactory assembly lines for materials handling and quality inspection tasks. The robots use on-device vision-language models for real-time part identification and can adapt to new task configurations with under 30 minutes of demonstration-based fine-tuning. Tesla reports a 22% improvement in dexterous manipulation accuracy over Gen 2, driven by redesigned tendon-actuated hands with 22 degrees of freedom.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Site Autonomy
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform tailored for construction environments, featuring autonomous navigation across unstructured terrain, heavy-object manipulation up to 30 kg, and real-time 3D site mapping. The system integrates with standard BIM software to execute task plans derived from architectural models. Early pilot programs with three major construction firms showed a 40% reduction in time spent on repetitive material transport tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework for Enterprise Agent Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise-grade framework for governing autonomous AI agents in production, combining constitutional AI principles with runtime monitoring, automated red-teaming, and human-in-the-loop escalation policies. The framework provides auditable decision traces and integrates with standard observability stacks like OpenTelemetry. Early adopters in financial services report measurably tighter adherence to compliance constraints while maintaining agent task-completion throughput.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over its 2nm node. The node is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from major fabless customers beginning in Q1 2027. Analysts note this keeps TSMC roughly one node ahead of Samsung Foundry and solidifies its dominance in leading-edge logic fabrication.

articles.title: Microsoft and Atom Computing Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Rates Below Fault-Tolerance Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Atom Computing jointly demonstrated a 24-logical-qubit neutral-atom quantum processor achieving error rates of 10⁻⁶ per logical gate, crossing below the threshold generally considered necessary for fault-tolerant quantum computation. The system uses a topological error-correction code co-designed with Microsoft's Azure Quantum stack. Researchers say this milestone opens a credible path to cryptographically relevant quantum computations within the next three to five years.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Bezos Expeditions and Microsoft, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in Texas with a target capacity of 10,000 units per year by 2028. Figure's latest Figure 03 prototype demonstrates autonomous warehouse order-picking at 85% the speed of human workers, using foundation models fine-tuned on proprietary manipulation datasets.
